name: Optimizing Fut terminal render pipeline without benchmark overfitting

description: Baseline broad render-pipeline score across feed, encode, decode, and clone workloads

asi.hypothesis: Establish a stable multi-workload baseline before changing production code
asi.benchmark_design: Eleven representative operations across plain, styled, TUI, and dense workloads; benchmark harness and metric are now frozen
asi.constraints: No cadence reductions, workload changes, fixture-specific paths, or semantic shortcuts

description: Inline cell strings with compact_str did not compile because Ghostty writes into String

asi.hypothesis: Store short cell graphemes inline to remove per-cell heap allocation from snapshot, clone, and decode paths
asi.error: libghostty_vt::CellIteration::graphemes_utf8 requires &mut String, not a generic writer or CompactString
asi.next_action_hint: Retry with Ghostty writing to a reusable String scratch buffer, then convert/move into CompactString; conversion preserves inline storage for normal graphemes

description: Inline short cell graphemes improved aggregate 17% but one test fixture did not compile

asi.hypothesis: Compact inline cell contents plus a reusable Ghostty extraction buffer removes thousands of heap allocations from every snapshot and clone
asi.result: Aggregate improved 16.96%; feed improved 18.2%, wire improved 14.9%, with especially large clone gains
asi.error: A domain test directly assigned format!(...) String to Cell.contents and needs .into()
asi.rollback_reason: Correctness checks must compile and pass
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the production change and convert the remaining test fixture String into CompactString, then rerun
